source_of_truth: code/api/app/brand_font_registry.py (lookup falls back to DEFAULT_FREE_ALTERNATIVE; openai font not in registry as sohne/soehne)
_meta.rationale: OpenAI's DRL tokens contain a font not in the registry (lookup falls through to DEFAULT_FREE_ALTERNATIVE but brand_font_first_preference is NOT None, so disclosure renders 'OpenAI uses Default free type system.'). Confirmed 2026-06-13 via prod DB probe. Primary display element on the alphabet template is h1.a-display-1. The :root override forces --ds-font-display to Inter. Negative assertion scans for slug=openai strip targets plus universal forbidden patterns.
gaps: No source-of-truth file pins a per-brand --ds-accent hex for openai (Phase 4 contract names ds-accent for buttons but does not pin a literal); computed_css color assertion deferred.

assertions.evaluate: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('h1.a-display-1'); if (!el) return false; const fam = window.getComputedStyle(el).fontFamily || ''; return fam.toLowerCase().includes('inter'); })()

assertions.expected_text: openai uses default free type system

assertions.evaluate: (() => { const html = document.documentElement.outerHTML.toLowerCase(); const forbidden = ['openai.com/logo', 'openai-logo', 'openai-wordmark', 'openai.svg', '/logo.svg', '/wordmark.svg', '/brand/logo']; return forbidden.every(s => !html.includes(s)); })()
